description: DATM boundary traces from an instrumented I-class CESM run (PLAN.md milestone M8, GSWP3v1 slice), default-gated by dump_datm=.false. and enabled in this run only. Two layers: (a) the streams layer (dshr_strdata_advance) dumps, per (stream, field, point): the lower/upper time-bound stream values lb/ub on the model grid after the spatial (bilinear ESMF) map, the time-interpolation factors flb/fub as returned by shr_tInterp_getFactors (and the coszen factor cosz/tavCosz for the Solar stream), and the interpolated value written into the datamode's field bundles; (b) the datamode layer (datm_datamode_clmncep_advance) dumps the interpolated stream values as consumed (strm_* pointers) and the exact export-state values (Sa_* state, Faxa_* fluxes, the Sx_* albedo imports used by Faxa_swnet), pinning the CLMNCEP derivation laws: tbot units detection/clamp, wind split u=v=wind/sqrt(2), qsat-vs-stream shum, density, pbot zero->pstd, the cam3_5_55 ratio_rvrf shortwave direct/diffuse split, the rain/snow ramp, and the swnet albedo weighting. The GSWP3v1 case runs the full 7-stream configuration (Solar coszen, Precip nearest, TPQW linear, presaero/presndep/preso3 linear pass-throughs, topo.observed lower), so the coszen/linear/nearest/lower interpolation laws are all traced.

regenerate.command:
source stage1/runs/env.sh && python3 stage1/cesm/cime/scripts/create_newcase --case stage1/cime/cases/I2000Clm60Sp_cdeps_inst --compset I2000Clm60Sp --res f19_f19_mg17 --machine illinois --run-unsupported --srcroot $PWD/stage1/EqESM-cesm-cdeps && cd stage1/cime/cases/I2000Clm60Sp_cdeps_inst && printf '
dump_datm = .true.
dump_dir = "<repo>/stage1/dumps/cdeps/"
dump_first_cells = 16
dump_first_steps = 12
' >> user_nl_datm && ./xmlchange STOP_OPTION=ndays,STOP_N=1,JOB_WALLCLOCK_TIME=02:00:00 && ./case.setup && ./case.build && env -u SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE -u SLURM_MEM_PER_CPU -u SLURM_MEM_PER_GPU ./case.submit
regenerate.note: Model source root is the fork worktree stage1/EqESM-cesm-cdeps (branch instrument/cdeps-dumps; cdeps submodule @9d6dc95, fox @7775cc3, share/genf90 @4816965 untouched; clm nested src/fates @121723f6 must be checked out for the CLM build). CIME scripts come from the pristine checkout stage1/cesm/cime. Dump CSVs land in stage1/dumps/cdeps/ (set by dump_dir in user_nl_datm; gitignored and regenerable); the run takes ~30 min wall (I2000Clm60Sp with CLM60).

run.job_id: 11979948 (initial run, dumps with pre-fix CSV header text) and 11982594 (final run after the 9d6dc95 description-text fix; both runs COMPLETED)
run.result: COMPLETED exit 0:0, case.run success, model execution success, st_archive success
run.dates: start 2000-01-01, STOP_OPTION=ndays STOP_N=1 (one day, 48 DATM advance calls at ATM_NCPL=48)
run.coupling: ATM_NCPL=48 (dt=1800 s coupling interval; DATM advance once per coupling step, 12 traced steps = first 6 h)
run.pes: TOTALPES=80 on 2 nodes (NTASKS=80 per component, 40/node; the xmlchange TOTALPES=36 was overridden by the machine pes derivation at case.setup). The reference run I2000Clm60Sp_f19 used TOTALPES=36 on 1 node; the restart files are nevertheless bit-identical (see checks), so the parallel decomposition does not perturb the traced results

namelist_deltas.note: All other settings identical to the reference run I2000Clm60Sp_f19 (job 11826959): same compset/grid/namelists, datamode CLMNCEP, streams CLMGSWP3v1.Solar (coszen) / CLMGSWP3v1.Precip (nearest) / CLMGSWP3v1.TPQW (linear) / presaero.clim_2000 (linear, 14 fields) / presndep.clim_2000_cmip6 (linear, 2 fields x1e-3) / preso3.clim_2000 (linear) / topo.observed (lower); all taxmode=cycle, readmode=single, mapalgo=bilinear, dtlimit=1.5; GSWP3 year_first/last/align 1991 (topo year 1). The dump code is additive (PET 0 pure reads + CSV writes) and gated off by default.

dump_files.cdeps_strdata_streams.csv: step,ymd,tod,ns,field,n,lon,lat,algo,lb,ub,flb,fub,value - streams layer (dshr_strdata_advance time-interp loop, one row per (stream, field, point)): lb/ub = fldbun_data(LB/UB) raw stream values on the model grid after the bilinear map, flb/fub = time-interpolation factors on lb/ub (algo coszen: flb = cosz/tavCosz via shr_tInterp_getCosz, fub = 0 unused; linear: value = flb*lb + fub*ub with flb+fub=1; nearest: (flb,fub) = (1,0) or (0,1); lower: (1,0)), value = the interpolant written into fldbun_model (algo coszen: value = lb*flb, 0 at night when cosz <= 0.001 even though flb > 0). ns = stream index (1=Solar, 2=Precip, 3=TPQW, 4=presaero, 5=presndep, 6=preso3, 7=topo.observed); ymd/tod is the (Feb-29-adjusted) model date used for the interpolation; lon/lat [deg] identify the point. 25 field-rows per (step, point): 1+1+5+14+2+1+1.
dump_files.datm_gswp3_streams.csv: step,ymd,tod,n,lon,lat,tbotmax,strm_tbot,strm_pbot,strm_wind,strm_shum,strm_lwdn,strm_swdn,strm_precn,strm_topo,strm_z - datamode layer inputs: the interpolated stream values as consumed by datm_datamode_clmncep_advance (the strm_* pointers into the model-grid field bundles after shr_strdata_advance). tbotmax [K] = first-call global max of Sa_tbot before the tkfrz adjustment (units detector: <50 means the stream temperature is in degC); strm_tbot [K], strm_pbot [Pa], strm_wind [m/s], strm_shum [kg/kg], strm_lwdn [W/m2], strm_swdn [W/m2], strm_precn [kg/m2/s], strm_topo [m], strm_z [m]; absent streams read 1e30 (= SHR_CONST_SPVAL; GSWP3v1 provides no z stream, so strm_z = 1e30 and the datamode substitutes 30 m).
dump_files.datm_gswp3_exports.csv: step,ymd,tod,n,lon,lat,tbotmax,anidrmax,Sa_topo,Sa_z,Sa_u,Sa_v,Sa_tbot,Sa_ptem,Sa_shum,Sa_dens,Sa_pbot,Sa_pslv,Sx_avsdr,Sx_anidr,Sx_avsdf,Sx_anidf,Faxa_rainc,Faxa_rainl,Faxa_snowc,Faxa_snowl,Faxa_swndr,Faxa_swndf,Faxa_swvdr,Faxa_swvdf,Faxa_swnet,Faxa_swdn,Faxa_lwdn - datamode layer outputs: the exact export-state values computed by datm_datamode_clmncep_advance at the traced points (after the bias-correction/anomaly-forcing block, which is inactive for the GSWP3 case). Sa_topo [m] = stream value (or 1e30 spval), Sa_z [m] = 30 m when the stream is absent, Sa_u/Sa_v [m/s] = wind/sqrt(2), Sa_tbot [K] (tkfrz added when tbotmax<50, clamped >= 180 K), Sa_ptem [K] = Sa_tbot, Sa_shum [kg/kg] = min(stream shum, qsat from the esat polynomial), Sa_dens [kg/m3], Sa_pbot [Pa] (pstd 101325 when 0 or stream absent), Sa_pslv [Pa] = Sa_pbot, Sx_avsdr/Sx_anidr/Sx_avsdf/Sx_anidf [-] albedo imports (1e30 spval when not present in the state, as in this case), Faxa_rainc/Faxa_rainl [kg/m2/s] = precn*0.1/0.9 scaled by the rain fraction, Faxa_snowc/Faxa_snowl [kg/m2/s] = rain0*(1-frac), Faxa_swndr/ndf/vdr/vdf [W/m2] = 0.5*swdn direct/diffuse split via the ratio_rvrf polynomials, Faxa_swnet [W/m2] (albedo-weighted sum, 0 when anidrmax is spval or < 1e-8, plain sum when the Sx imports are absent), Faxa_swdn [W/m2] = stream swdn, Faxa_lwdn [W/m2] = stream lwdn. anidrmax = first-call global max of the Sx_anidr import (existence detector).

traced_domain.pet: 0 only (dump_pet gate; streams layer additionally gated on istr=='datm' and mainproc)
traced_domain.cells: first 16 mesh points of PET 0 (dump_first_cells=16) in the cap's 1-D state order (n = 1..model_lsize, the index used in the datamode loops); lon/lat columns identify the points (point 1 = lon 0, lat -90, the south-pole-adjacent cell)
traced_domain.steps: first 12 advance calls (dump_first_steps=12) of the 48-call day, steps 0..11 (step counters start at -1 and increment once per advance)
traced_domain.steps_note: coszen rows for night points (cosz <= 0.001) carry value=0 with flb>0 - the law's night branch; the trace therefore covers both branches of the coszen law.

checks.bit_identical_outputs: instrumented run restart files (clm2.r, cpl.r, datm.r, dglc.r, mosart.r, all 2000-01-02-00000) are bit-identical to the reference I2000Clm60Sp_f19 run's restart files (np.ma.allequal over every data variable; masked entries masked in both) - verified for both runs 11979948 and 11982594, so the dump code changes nothing when enabled (stage1/analysis/check_datm_neutral.py). Notably the instrumented case ran on a different pes decomposition (80 tasks/2 nodes vs 36/1 node) and is still bit-identical
checks.stream_interp_laws: all 4800 streams-layer rows verified to round-off: coszen value = lb*flb (fub=0; night rows value=0), linear value = flb*lb + fub*ub with flb+fub=1, nearest (flb,fub) in {(1,0),(0,1)}, lower = (1,0) (stage1/analysis/check_datm_laws.py)
checks.datamode_laws: all 192 datamode rows verified to round-off against datm_datamode_clmncep_mod.F90 and shr_precip_mod.F90: Sa_tbot units/clamp, Sa_ptem, wind split, Sa_pbot zero->pstd, Sa_pslv, Sa_shum = min(qsat(esat), stream), Sa_dens, rainc/rainl/snowc/snowl via the rain ramp frac = clamp((tbot-273.15)*0.5, 0, 1), swndr/ndf/vdr/vdf via ratio_rvrf (cam3_5_55 polynomials), Faxa_swnet = 0 (Sx imports spval in this case), Faxa_swdn/lwdn pass-throughs, Sa_topo/Sa_z
checks.row_counts: cdeps_strdata_streams.csv 12 steps x 16 points x 25 field-rows = 4800 data rows (+2 header lines); datm_gswp3_streams.csv and datm_gswp3_exports.csv 12 x 16 = 192 data rows each
checks.no_blank_lines: all 3 CSVs have zero blank lines; headers are '# description = ...' / '# columns = ...' with the spval text corrected to 1e30 (= SHR_CONST_SPVAL) in commit 9d6dc95
checks.reproducibility: both runs produced identical row counts and law-verified values; the run-1 CSVs were overwritten in place by the final run, so no byte-level diff was retained
